mathematics: valid and robust: the 18-vertex r = 5 witness and an infinite family for every r >= 6 refute Tian-Dong Conjecture 6.1 (arXiv:2603.12770v1) beyond its order threshold
reasons: The cited Liu-Song-Zhan-Lai family (Discrete Math. 346 (2023) 113402, Section 5) is, after normalising the partition, exactly the complete balanced split graph F_s = K_s join (s independent vertices), with the same balanced independent-set gap obstruction; it misses the conjecture's order bound 2r+7 only because its order is 2r.

The candidate is F_m with cyclic cross-edge perfect matchings deleted (the held witness is F_9 minus offsets {4,6,7,8}; for r >= 6, F_{r+4} minus four matchings), with an elementary intersection bound for the K_(1,r+1)+e exclusion: a short augmentation-and-sparsification of a construction published before the conjecture.
This is the 341250 profile (a valid obstruction that is a short augmentation of a published construction), so zero credit.
